MB Maddie Bell April 7, 2026 16 min read If you run your sales motion on HubSpot, you have probably started evaluating AI SDR tools. Every vendor claims a HubSpot integration. Most of them have one. Technically. 
 But there is a meaningful difference between an AI SDR that writes data to HubSpot and one that reads signals from HubSpot. The first treats your CRM as a logging destination. The second uses it as an intelligence layer, reading lifecycle stage changes, deal velocity, email engagement, and form submissions to decide who to engage, when , and how . 
 That distinction matters because the AI SDR you choose shapes how much of the buyer journey you can actually cover. Most tools handle one part: outbound sequencing, or inbound chat, or meeting booking. But between first touch and attended meeting, there are a dozen handoff points where pipeline leaks. The question is whether your AI SDR can manage the full journey or just one slice of it. 
 We looked at eight AI SDR platforms that HubSpot teams are evaluating right now to help you figure out which one fits your actual constraint, not just which one has the most features on a checklist. If you are still sorting out what AI SDRs actually do , start there, then come back for the HubSpot-specific breakdown.
